question: Should scoped agent run tokens be allowed to read raw WorkItem intents? The investigate scope can already read them over REST, but only for the run's own WorkItem (its BindWorkItem route ^/api/v1/work-items/([^/]+)(/.*)?$ covers /intents). So option 2 only works if it also closes that REST route, not just the MCP tool.
reason: The issue says this needs an owner decision. The proposal goes ahead with option 1, bounded to the run's own WorkItem, but the owner must confirm it or choose option 2.

options: Option 1: accept, bounded to the run's own WorkItem (as proposed)
Option 2: exclude for scoped runs, closing both the MCP tool and the REST /intents routes
